name: Prepare native build tools
command:
set -e
sudo -n apt-get update
sudo -n apt-get install -y pkg-config libsecret-1-dev xz-utils
mkdir -p /tmp/t3code-nix-latest-sync
curl --fail --location --silent --show-error https://releases.nixos.org/nix/nix-2.28.5/nix-2.28.5-x86_64-linux.tar.xz -o /tmp/t3code-nix-latest-sync/nix.tar.xz
tar -xJf /tmp/t3code-nix-latest-sync/nix.tar.xz -C /tmp/t3code-nix-latest-sync
sudo -n install -d -o "$(id -u)" -g "$(id -g)" /nix
/tmp/t3code-nix-latest-sync/nix-2.28.5-x86_64-linux/install --no-daemon --no-modify-profile
"$HOME/.nix-profile/bin/nix" --version
